ghats.name: Edupayala Seven Streams River Ghats
ghats.description: Sacred riverbank where Manjeera River splits into seven streams surrounding the Swayambhu cave deity. Features Kalyana Katta tonsure complexes and safe bathing channels.

significance: According to Bhavishyothara Purana, Maharaja Janamejaya performed a Sarpa Yagna here; the seven streams were formed to wash away the ashes and purify the site. During monsoons, the rising Manjeera River flows directly over the feet of the Goddess (Jala Abhishekam / Charan Sparsh).
safety_rules: During monsoons (July-Sept) or when Singur Dam gates are opened upstream, water levels rise extremely fast. Strictly avoid swimming or entering the river when warning signs are placed. Bathe only at designated safe ghats equipped with security railings.
